description: FORMAT EXAMPLE for the recall eval set. Copy to queries.local.json (gitignored) and fill with your own held-out queries. Guidance: mine 'mined' queries from real session transcripts (natural phrasing -- avoid authoring queries from the target memory's own keywords, that rigs the FTS leg to win by construction); add 'paraphrase' queries that share meaning but not literal tokens with the target; include every language your corpus contains. Label expected IDs from ground-truth knowledge (metadata/title browsing), not query-token search. Metric: recall@10 = |found in top10 / expected| / |expected|, macro-averaged, with per-language and per-source slices.
